Cleaning an easy clean grid. The cores slide out of the tubes and the iron falls off.

In a plain grid the operator scrapes the iron off each rod. In an easy clean grid the magnets sit inside outer tubes. Release the toggle clamps and lift the core frame. The tubes lose their magnetism and the collected iron falls off.
This matters on lines that are cleaned several times a shift, and in food and pharmaceutical plants where the operator should touch the product zone as little as possible.
The grid mounts on a flanged square frame drilled to match the hopper or chute. It is made in 304 stainless steel to your size and comes with a tested certificate of magnetic strength.

Overview - Gauss Meter
Proof that the magnets still work
Magnet strength falls if a separator is overheated or knocked hard. An audit needs a number, and the number should be compared with the tested certificate supplied with the unit.

Press the probe to the rod or plate face and read the meter. Log the figure against the certificate. We use the same meters to certify every separator that leaves the works, and supply them to customers who run their own yearly checks.

Overview - High Intensity Magnetic Liquid Traps
Protection for pumps, valves and the product
Iron in the liquid holds to the rods. To clean, lift the rod cluster out and wipe it.
Liquid enters the trap, passes over a cluster of magnetic rods and leaves through the outlet. Iron and fine wear particles hold to the rods. Nothing is consumed and the flow is unrestricted.

The in-line trap has a 75 mm rod cluster, 250 mm long, with 7 rods. The housed trap has a 150 mm cluster with 9 rods. Both have bolted flanges. A jacketed version keeps a product such as chocolate or syrup warm as it passes.
To clean, release the lid clamps, lift the rod cluster out and wipe the rods. Used for syrups, sauces, oils, coolants, hydraulic oil, liquid chemicals and slurries.

Overview - Housed Bullet Magnetic Separator
Every path through the housing passes a magnet
Product falls through two rows of rods, offset so that no particle can drop straight through. Nails, wire, swarf and fine iron hold to the rods while the product carries on down the line.
To clean, open the toggle clamped door and draw each drawer out. The rods come clear of the product zone and are wiped down in seconds. The line does not need to be opened.
Used in gravity and lean phase pneumatic lines in milling, plastics, chemicals and food. Made to your bore and flange pattern.

Overview - Housed Easy Clean Grid Magnetic Separator
Fine iron removed inside a closed housing

The product falls through a hood, passes over the grid and leaves through a cone. The housing is sealed between the hood and the cone, so no dust escapes and nothing gets in. The rods hold nails, wire, rust and fine wear particles.

To clean, release the clamps and lift the grid out. The collected iron is wiped off and the grid goes back in. A double or triple row housing gives more rods in the product path for higher throughput or finer particles.
Common positions are under a silo, at a hopper outlet, and just before packing. The housing is made to your line size in 304 stainless steel and comes with a tested certificate of magnetic strength.

Overview - Housed Underflow Magnetic Separator
Separation inside the duct
When the product runs inside closed ducting, the separator has to live in the line. This housing bolts between flanges and puts staggered rows of rods in the path of everything that passes.
Cleaning works like our bullet housing. Unclamp the door, draw the rods out, wipe them and slide them back. The duct joints are never broken. Rods are available from 7,000 to 13,500 gauss.

Magnetic Separators | Santosh Magnetic Works
Magnets that take iron out of your product
Iron gets into a product line with the raw material, from worn machine parts and from maintenance work. A magnetic separator pulls it out before it damages a machine or reaches a customer.

We make separators for dry powders, granules, liquids and slurries. Grids and grates sit in hoppers. Drawer housings and bullet magnets fit into pipes and ducts. Liquid traps go into pipelines. Plate and chute magnets work over conveyors and inside chutes.

Every unit is built at our works in Mumbai from 304 stainless steel and neodymium rods in four strengths, up to 13,500 gauss. Each one leaves with a tested certificate of magnetic strength. Sizes are made to your hopper, pipe or chute.
